title: Candidate/admission invariant enforced by aggregation with a fixture-based negative probe
invariant: An aggregate record may set admitted=true only when a non-empty reproductionReceipt, at least one non-empty evidenceRefs entry, and a non-empty dossierIdentity all exist; admissionRecords is a required array even when empty, so an admission cannot be hidden by omission.

negativeProbe.fixture: { candidateId: 'c1', admitted: true } with no receipt, evidence, or dossier
negativeProbe.observed: rejected; a partially-populated record names the missing evidenceRefs and dossierIdentity fields
